property_summary: For any call to fallback that sends exactly 10 ether and occurs at a strictly later timestamp than pastBlockTime, the reference contract always sets pastBlockTime to block.timestamp + 1 after the call; the mutant sets pastBlockTime to block.timestamp for some inputs, violating that rule.
change_summary: Set pastBlockTime to block.timestamp (instead of block.timestamp + 1), causing a different stored value after the call.
